# 3 bedroom semi-detached house for sale

> We are delighted to present this well-presented four-bedroom semi-detached property, ideally situated in a quiet no-through road in Chichester. Offering light and spacious accommodation arranged over three floors, the property provides a versatile layout ideal for families, professionals or those looking for additional bedroom space.
